headline: HuyenBao v11.38 — sửa 3D button (color-mix→rgba), thu nhỏ button + menu
summary: BUTTON FIX. v11.37's 3D buttons used color-mix() which rendered FLAT in some browsers — now rebuilt with plain rgba() gradients that render everywhere. The 3D effect is now visible: top-highlight gradient + solid bottom-rim shadow + drop shadow on every button (.ibtn, .gig, nav tabs). Hover lifts -1px, press sinks +1px. Buttons also smaller: .ibtn padding 6px→5px, font .86rem→.8rem, min-width 104px→92px, border-radius 999px→10px (sharper). .gig buttons get 3D too (were flat cards). Nav tabs shrunk more: gnav .82rem→.78rem, subnav .74rem→.7rem.
features: 3D BUTTON FIX: replaced color-mix() with plain rgba() — renders in ALL browsers (was flat in some)
3D on .gig buttons: gig cards now have gradient + rim shadow + hover lift (were flat)
3D on nav tabs: gnav active tab gets gold gradient + rim shadow
SMALLER BUTTONS: .ibtn padding 6px→5px, font .86rem→.8rem, min-width 104px→92px, radius 999px→10px
SMALLER NAV: gnav .82rem→.78rem padding 6px→5px; subnav .74rem→.7rem padding 4px→3px
